area_note: Central and South Jakarta, mainly the Senayan (GBK) and Sudirman–SCBD areas
intro: Jakarta's club runs centre on the Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) sports complex in Senayan and the nearby Sudirman–SCBD business district. Weekday groups meet either early in the morning or after work in the evening, and several crews start from buildings and cafés in SCBD, Senopati and Kuningan. On Sunday mornings, Car Free Day closes Jalan Sudirman to traffic, and community fun runs there start as early as 5:30am. Most local groups announce their sessions on Instagram rather than on websites.

clubs.name: Indo Runners
clubs.description: An independent running community founded in Jakarta in 2009, with chapters in other Indonesian cities, including Bali. Its Instagram account has about 122,000 followers. Its technique and training group, IR Runiversity (listed below), holds a Sunday morning social run from FX Sudirman.

clubs.name: IR Runiversity
clubs.who: Runners who want to learn technique
clubs.description: Part of the Indo Runners community. It focuses on teaching running technique and development, and adds weekly strength training to its Sunday social run.

clubs.name: Jakbrunners (Jakarta Barat Runners)

meets.when: Some Sunday mornings (5K/10K fun runs, announced in Instagram stories)

clubs.description: Founded in May 2014 under the hashtag #YourRunningBuddies. The group also holds non-running social activities for members.

clubs.name: Skolari

meets.where: East side of Wisma Serbaguna, Senayan

clubs.who: Open to the public; beginners and experienced runners
clubs.description: A free community set up in January 2019 by runners who wanted a group with no barriers or exclusivity. It also runs a kids' training programme and speed sessions, which take sign-ups through its Linktree.

clubs.name: Thunder Light Jakarta

meets.when: Wednesdays 7pm (Wednesday Session: coached workouts such as cardio or strength)

clubs.who: Open to everyone; no requirements to join
clubs.description: A fun-running crew formed in February 2020 by friends who ran together at night. It supports members training for half and full marathons and runs a cheering zone at races, including the 2026 Jakarta Running Festival.

clubs.name: adidas Runners Jakarta
clubs.description: The adidas brand running community in Jakarta. With Maybank Marathon it ran the public Road to Maybank Marathon 2026 training programme from 3 May to 16 August 2026, which included coaching clinics, long runs, strength, hill and heat-adaptation training.

clubs.name: teman kumparan Running Club

meets.when: Periodic Sunday fun runs, gathering from 5:30am (dates announced by kumparan)
meets.where: Car Free Day, Sudirman; recent runs started from GBK Gate 6

clubs.who: All levels, from beginners to experienced runners
clubs.description: The reader community running club of the news site kumparan. Its Car Free Day fun runs have pacers and include free refreshments. Runners join through the club's group link (kum.pr/running).
clubs.active_evidence: Fun runs on 28 Jun 2026 and 18 Oct 2026 (kumparan, 19 Oct 2026)

clubs.name: Running Rage
clubs.description: One of Jakarta's longest-running crews, founded in 2011. It describes itself as covering running, lifestyle and the outdoors.

clubs.name: Manifest

meets.when: Tuesdays 6am (moderate pace, short distance, with a tempo option)

clubs.who: Easy-pace Sunday runs suit most runners; Tuesdays are aimed at intermediate runners
clubs.description: A social run club founded in December 2024 and supported by Nike Running. Its Sunday runs have a water station at about 5–7 km.

clubs.name: Selari

meets.where: GBK Gate 5 (Pintu 5), by the Soekarno statue

clubs.description: A Jakarta running community built around a weekly Sunday run at GBK. It takes new members through a sign-up form linked from its Instagram profile.

clubs.name: One Eighty Run
clubs.description: A running community whose motto is "We Run With You". Its Strava club, which lists the weekly sessions, has about 500 members.

clubs.name: MAEM Running Club
clubs.description: An urban running crew founded in 2015 whose motto is "Run – Eat – Joy"; maem is a colloquial word for eating, and runs are followed by a meal together.

clubs.name: Running with Rhyme and Peace (RWRP)

meets.when: Sundays 5am (Sunday Sunrise, easy to medium pace)
Thursdays 7pm (Night Run, easy pace, short distance)

clubs.description: A small crew that runs year-round, with a Sunday sunrise run at GBK and a Thursday night run from a café in Cikini. It also has a Strava club.

coaches.name: Runners Lab
coaches.offers: Customised training programmes for all levels that combine running, strength, mobility and recovery; payment in full or by instalments (prices not published on the site)
coaches.where: Sessions at GBK Stadium, Mid Plaza and Pacific Place, per its website
coaches.credentials: Head coach Donny Tj; the site says its coaches are certified but does not name the bodies
coaches.description: A paid running programme with a head coach and a team of strength and conditioning coaches, who tailor plans to each runner's goal and experience. Enquiries go through WhatsApp or Instagram.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 2-5 Nov 2026; website checked 6 Nov 2026

coaches.name: Andriyanto (TrackTeam)
coaches.offers: Online training for runners of all levels, arranged by Instagram DM; he also coaches TrackTeam (@trackteam.id), a selective club of performance-focused runners who train together on the track
coaches.where: Online; TrackTeam trains in Jakarta (a 2022 Warta Kota profile described weekly Wednesday sessions at Stadion Soemantri Brodjonegoro, Kuningan)
coaches.credentials: UESCA and Revo2lution Running coaching certificates (Warta Kota, 2022); his bio cites two US running-coach certifications
coaches.description: A former Reuters journalist who now coaches full time. TrackTeam members prepare for big-city marathons, some chasing Boston qualifying times.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 30 Sep to 3 Nov 2026; TrackTeam Instagram posts to 3 Nov 2026

coaches.name: Yehezkiel L (Yeskiversity)
coaches.offers: 1:1 online coaching, enquiries by Instagram DM; his story highlights also cover corporate coaching and strength training for runners (prices not published)
coaches.credentials: Describes himself as a certified running coach and a 3:15 marathoner
coaches.description: A Jakarta-based running coach who also runs @yeskiversity, an account for his coaching content and athlete testimonials.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 3 Oct to 2 Nov 2026; Jakarta location from his Threads bio

coaches.name: Harris Silaban (Kelas Bersama Silaban)
coaches.offers: Coaching through his Kelas Bersama Silaban group (@kelasbersamasilaban), whose runners raced the Jakarta Running Festival in October 2026; enquiries through Instagram (prices not published)
coaches.credentials: World Athletics CECS Level 1 coach; UESCA certified running coach; ICCA strength and conditioning
coaches.description: A certified running coach based in Jakarta who coaches his own group and, in recent posts, Ardiles Running Club.
coaches.active_evidence: Instagram posts, 17 Oct to 3 Nov 2026; Kelas Bersama Silaban posts, 13 Sep to 27 Oct 2026
